title: Wheel of Loot
description:
A broadcast prize wheel driven by a Foundry RollTable. The GM presents a wheel to the whole table and nominates who may spin it; every client watches the same wheel land on the same slice. The winner gets confetti and a keep / gift / refuse choice, and keeping it puts the item straight onto their sheet.

Built for D&D 5e — rarity colours on the rim, coin wedges that pay into the right purse, and a browser that knows a three-charge wand from a one-use scroll. Runs in any system: everything system-specific lives behind one small adapter, and a world with no adapter simply hides the affordances it cannot support instead of showing controls that would do nothing.

The module ships no prizes of its own. A wheel is filled from your own world — your compendiums, your homebrew, or prizes you type in — and the builder exists to make that quick.

Comes with a wheel builder: browse every Item in your world and compendiums, drag them onto the wheel, choose how many slots it has, and re-roll any wedge you do not like. Prizes that are not items at all — a favour owed, a title, a rumour, homebrew you have not written up — go on as custom wedges. A dry run spins the wheel exactly as your players will see it, granting nothing.
